scripts.check: npm run kv:configure:dry-run && wrangler types --include-runtime false --check -c wrangler.check.jsonc && tsc --noEmit && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c wrangler.check.jsonc
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run kv:configure:dry-run && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c wrangler.check.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run kv:configure && node scripts/apply-kv-namespace-id.mjs --verify-deployable && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.dev: npm run kv:configure && wrangler dev -c wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.test: node --test scripts/apply-kv-namespace-id.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/rate-limit.test.mjs tests/device-readiness.test.ts tests/apple-auth.test.ts
